zh-CN.title: 一滴日记卡片与限时阅读
items: 选择一滴日记后直接发送，卡片展示文字摘要与分享倒计时。
点击卡片即可在友间阅读正文、播放声音与查看位置，分享到期后自动停止展示。

en.title: Drop diary cards and time-limited reading
items: Selected Drop diaries send directly, with text excerpts and a share countdown on their cards.
Read diaries, play recordings and view shared locations in Frienden. Content closes automatically when its share expires.
